subject: Q2 owners' covenant & exec readiness — OKR calibration request
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Alli Harris <alli@brightbyte.com>, procurement@brightbyte.com
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 owners' covenant & exec readiness — OKR calibration request

Team —

As discussed in last week's leadership sync, we need to lock the OKR ownership and gating criteria for Q2 by the end of this week so execs can sign off before the QBR packet is finalized. BrightByte is in the initial onboarding window and has requested explicit owner commitments for the integration milestones that map to our cost/latency OKRs.

Action items I need from owners by EOD Wednesday:
- Confirm owner(s) for each KRx in the attached OKR_Covenant_Q2_v1.xlsx (column H).
- Short justification (1-2 lines) for any target that deviates >15% from Q1 run-rate.
- Call out any hard blockers (procurement, infra region limitations, data access) so we can escalate now.

Alli — looping you in so you and procurement have visibility to the milestone owners; if BrightByte needs a PO or SOW before we sign off, flag here and we will coordinate.

Attachments: OKR_Covenant_Q2_v1.xlsx, Q2_metrics_packet.pdf, BrightByte_SOW_draft.docx

Thanks,
Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Alli Harris <alli@brightbyte.com>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 owners' covenant & exec readiness — OKR calibration request

Thanks Nikhil — quick clarifying questions before I fill out the spreadsheet:
1) For the "P95 latency under 120ms" KR, do we want to treat BrightByte as a separate SLA bucket (they're in EU region and on a dedicated pool) or fold into the global latency KR?
2) On the "integration milestones" sheet, the date for "schema contract" reads 4/28/26 — assume that's a typo and should be 6/28/26?

I'll start filling owner columns for Platform and DX once those two are clarified. If we plan to treat BrightByte separately, I propose a companion KR that scopes to "BrightByte pilot" so we keep the global metric clean.

-L

Hi Nikhil / Lauren —

Thanks for the heads up and for looping procurement. For clarity: BrightByte is fine being called out as a separate pilot KR for the first two quarters. Procurement has started a SOW review and expects a redline back by next Tuesday; I've attached a single-slide summary of the commercial milestones and a link to the DocuSign packet for the preliminary SOW.

We have one ask: can you confirm the owner for the "cost per 1M tokens" measurement so finance can map to the PO? If you can include the measurement owner in the covenant sheet we can move the SOW forward.

Attachments: BB_SOW_summary_slide.pdf
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/packet/brightbyte-q2-endorsement

—Alli
Alli Harris
Head of Partnerships, BrightByte
alli@brightbyte.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Alli Harris <alli@brightbyte.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 owners' covenant & exec readiness — OKR calibration request

Agree with Lauren that BrightByte should be a scoped pilot KR. On measurement owner: I'll own the "cost per 1M tokens" metric for the pilot, with finance support from Rishi. I'll update the covenant sheet now and add a short note on assumptions (burst traffic, tokenization variance) in column I.

One operational note: if procurement needs the dedicated pool region callout in the SOW, let procurement@brightbyte.com know we will require eu-west-1 as the primary region for the pilot; fallback to us-west-2 is okay for testing but will impact latency KRs.

Vivek
Senior VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Alli Harris <alli@brightbyte.com>, procurement@brightbyte.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 owners' covenant & exec readiness — OKR calibration request

Thanks all — quick update and next steps:

1) Decision: BrightByte will be scoped as a pilot KR (separate companion KR) for Q2 and Q3; Vivek will own the pilot cost metric and Rishi will be finance lead for measurement.
2) Lauren — the schema date was indeed a typo, update to 2026-06-28; we should call that out in the QBR appendix.
3) Alli — procurement note on region (eu-west-1 primary) acknowledged; please add that to the SOW redline and we'll coordinate cutover windows with the Platform team.
4) Owners: I've updated the covenant spreadsheet (column H) with the owners you named; please add your 1-2 line justifications and any blocker flags by EOD Wednesday.

I'll consolidate the final owner list and route to execs for sign-off on Thursday morning so the QBR packet stays on schedule.

Closing the loop — thanks for quick replies.

Nikhil
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
